attchmntText: Starteck Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Starteck Finance Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. Consolidated profit after tax for the half year was 1,192.34 lakh. Standalone profit after tax for the half year was 1,155.68 lakh. Consolidated basic earnings per share for the half year was 12.03. Standalone basic earnings per share for the half year was 11.66. Consolidated total income for the half year was 3,513.70 lakh. Standalone total income for the half year was 3,403.31 lakh. The results were subjected to a limited review by statutory auditors.
